approvers: Main contractor and developer; glazing supplier for warranty
reason: We don't buy this today, so it would mean a new supplier and a new budget line. ACHV is a contractor too, and I don't want a competitor on my site or seeing my programme. A confidentiality undertaking doesn't change that for me.
objection: I don't want a competitor's people near my frames and my programme, and a coating on coated glass and finishes could mark them. A free test panel and a 2,500 euro cap on damage don't cover a rejected unit or a delay at handover.
instead: Keep using our own protection film and tape and careful site sequencing, and charge back damage to the trades that cause it.
would_change_my_mind: Written compatibility confirmation from the coating maker for our specific glass coatings and frame finishes. A Maltese reference on a glazed block. A guarantee that only an independent applicator touches our site, with no ACHV visits beyond a test panel I control.
